analyzers.manifest:
# First-party manifest: how holdmap runs SkillSpector (https://github.com/NVIDIA/SkillSpector).
# holdmap never installs it; the user does, then approves this exact manifest and binary.
schema = 1
id = "nvidia.skillspector"
name = "SkillSpector"
publisher = "NVIDIA"
homepage = "https://github.com/NVIDIA/SkillSpector"
license = "Apache-2.0"
summary = "Static scan of agent skills for prompt injection, data exfiltration, dangerous code and vulnerable dependencies."
install = "uv tool install git+https://github.com/NVIDIA/skillspector.git@v2.13.0"

[runner]
kind = "cli"
command = "skillspector"
args = ["scan", "{subject.dir}", "--format", "json", "--no-llm", "--output", "{output}"]
per_subject = "skill"
version_args = ["--version"]
version_prefix = "SkillSpector v"
timeout_secs = 120
max_output_mb = 8
exit_ok = [0, 1]

[permissions]
read = ["{subject.dir}"]
network = ["api.osv.dev"]
network_reason = "SkillSpector looks up dependency versions it finds in the skill on OSV and has no switch to turn that off."
sends = ["Package names and versions found in the skill go to api.osv.dev."]
spawns_mcp_servers = false

[output]
format = "json-map"
items = "$.issues[*]"
rule_id = "id"
category = "category"
severity = "severity"
title = "pattern"
fix = "remediation"
file = "location.file"
line = "location.start_line"
fingerprint = "match_fingerprint"
status = "analysis_completeness.status"
coverage_percent = "analysis_completeness.coverage_percent"

[[output.details]]
label = "Risk score"
path = "risk_assessment.score"
suffix = " / 100"

[[output.details]]
label = "Recommendation"
path = "risk_assessment.recommendation"

# Built-in: look up the exact, pinned package versions MCP definitions launch on OSV.dev.
schema = 1
id = "holdmap.osv"
name = "OSV vulnerability lookup"
publisher = "holdmap"
homepage = "https://osv.dev"
license = "Apache-2.0"
summary = "Checks pinned npm and PyPI packages that your MCP servers launch against the OSV.dev vulnerability database."

[runner]
kind = "builtin"
per_subject = "packages"
timeout_secs = 30

[permissions]
network = ["api.osv.dev"]
network_reason = "OSV.dev is a public vulnerability database run by Google; the lookup happens there."
sends = ["The ecosystem, name and exact version of each pinned package. Nothing else: no paths, file contents, environment or machine details."]

[output]
format = "osv"
